verdict.rationale: The Agent SDK bundles the official `claude` CLI (Claude Code CLI) automatically, and Anthropic documents a full CLI reference, so an official CLI clearly exists and is usable programmatically and interactively. However, hands-on community reports describe the bundled CLI/harness as having poor observability, messy tool-call display, and limited extensibility, suggesting real DX gaps. Missing for 10: independent corroboration of a polished CLI experience, and resolution of the observability/extensibility complaints raised by users.
